declared_by: user, who authorised in chat on 2026-10-24 the declaration of the final523 analysis rules and their hash; the assistant drafted the choices and the reasons listed under `reasons`
declared_before_viewing: any final523 score. Only the generation bundle, readiness receipt and selection300 outcomes existed; no final523 output, ledger or start authorization had been created
purpose: Confirm, on the sealed 523-ID test cohort, the choice locked at selection300 (LED ngram3). Not a new selection: nothing here can change the locked profile.

1_result_labels.not_evaluable: a coverage or common-set floor of declaration 3 is missed, or the scoring run was partial; the confirmatory test is then not run and only descriptive tables are reported, labelled partial
1_result_labels.recorded: immediately after one run, as text-free JSON with input/engine/declaration hashes; no waiting for approval
1_result_labels.single_run: the engine runs once on the real scores; no re-run to try another reading

2_primary_metric.metric: ROUGE-L F1 (unicode_word_lcs_rouge_l_f1_v1) of the delivered 350-word output against the creator abstract
2_primary_metric.unit: per-ID paired difference, mean over C_final
secondary_descriptive: BERTScore F1 at the delivered view
ROUGE-L and BERTScore at views S/M/L = 60/120/240 words (view_policy_v1)
wall seconds per record per profile from the ledger (not a standardised latency benchmark)
2_primary_metric.source_sbert: kept in the artefacts as a diagnostic; never reported as quality or factuality, never used in a decision (admission_rules_v2)

3_populations_and_missing_cells.C_final: IDs scored-success for all four profiles (scored_success = generation completed or completed_with_warning, and ROUGE-L F1 finite)
3_populations_and_missing_cells.failures: null, never zero; interrupted `started` records count as failed cells; no retry, no imputation, no dropping of hard IDs
3_populations_and_missing_cells.floors: identical to admission_rules_v2: per-profile coverage >= 0.95 overall and >= 0.90 per stratum; C_final >= 0.90 of 523 overall, >= 0.80 per stratum, |C_final| >= 180; strata with >= 20 members in C_final are considered
3_populations_and_missing_cells.sensitivity_descriptive: per-contrast pairwise-complete means (each contrast on the IDs where just its two profiles succeeded), plus missing counts by profile and stratum; never a gate
3_populations_and_missing_cells.never: evaluate on a completed prefix, or fill a missing LED cell with another profile's output

4_confirmatory_family.inference: paired percentile bootstrap, 10000 resamples, seed 20261024, IDs resampled within stratum (523 distinct source groups, so ID is the independence unit)
4_confirmatory_family.interval: 97.5% two-sided interval per contrast (Bonferroni over the two contrasts, family alpha 0.05)
4_confirmatory_family.criterion_confirmed: the lower bound of both intervals is > 0 AND the Lead-3 guard holds
4_confirmatory_family.lead3_guard: mean(led minus lead3) >= 0.0 on C_final (epsilon 1e-12; exactly 0 passes)
4_confirmatory_family.not_confirmed_meaning: the locked choice stays as it was and is reported as unconfirmed on test; it is neither swapped for another profile nor re-selected (forbidden_after_scores)

5_reported_but_not_gating.practical_margin: for each confirmatory contrast report whether the mean difference is >= 0.01 (the selection300 margin); a descriptive flag, not part of the criterion
5_reported_but_not_gating.strata: per-stratum means, differences and the same interval method for short/medium/long; stratum sign reversals are listed and do not change the label
5_reported_but_not_gating.other_pairs: the remaining pairwise differences of the four profiles (at most 6 pairs in all) with unadjusted intervals, labelled exploratory
5_reported_but_not_gating.effect_with_interval: every number is reported with its interval; no p-value ranking of profiles

6_views_S_M_L.tests: for both contrasts and both metrics, a paired bootstrap per view; Holm-adjusted over the three views (family size 3 as in view_policy_v1, even where views are identical)
6_views_S_M_L.duplicates: report per profile the share of IDs whose S, M and L texts are identical; Lead-3 and BART are expected to be near-duplicates, so their view rows are not independent evidence
6_views_S_M_L.meaning: views are prefix slices of the stored output (the first N words); they do not measure the ability to write an N-word summary

7_post_result_diagnostics.cases: 36 IDs, 12 per stratum: the 4 most negative and the 4 most positive (led minus bart) ROUGE-L deltas on C_final, and 4 drawn with seed 20261024 from the rest
7_post_result_diagnostics.when: selected and listed only after the result file is written; reading text is allowed only then
7_post_result_diagnostics.meaning: qualitative error analysis, not rates and not new gold labels

declarations.8_claim_limits: agreement with the creator abstract and pipeline cost on a finite English TIB test cohort. No factuality, key-idea preservation, unseen-domain generalisation or audio/image benefit is claimed, and nothing here applies to other video sets.

forbidden_after_scores: change the leader, rivals or membership
change metric, views, seed or resample count
open trials or tune a profile on test
drop IDs or cells because of their score
engine_requirement: a text-free analysis engine reading only metrics.jsonl, view_metrics.jsonl and these bound files is built and tested on synthetic data before any real final523 score is read; its sha256 is recorded in the result. Until it exists this file is the only authority.

reasons.confirmatory_not_selection: the choice is already locked and a second selection on test would spend the test set; the question is only whether the advantage replicates
reasons.interval_not_margin: selection300 led-bart was +0.0136, barely above the 0.01 margin; requiring >= 0.01 again on a fresh sample would be close to a coin flip even if the effect is real. The margin stays as a reported flag
reasons.no_stratum_gate: each test stratum has about 170-180 IDs; gating on three more sign tests per contrast inflates false not_confirmed. Strata are reported, not gating
